name: Maioka Kaede
source:
Kaede is [url=https://vndb.org/c42426]Momiji[/url]'s mother and [url=https://vndb.org/c63887]Shinobu[/url]'s foster mother. She used to be an experienced nurse at Saint Michael's General Hospital, but since last year, she started working as a teacher at Saint Michael's Nursing School instead. Kaede still looks very young and has a very glamorous body. On top of it, she is also aggressive in her sexual pursuits and has very good techniques in bed. She has a certain hold on Shinobu, not only because she raised him, but also because she was his first love! Of course, he was just a child and she rebuffed him back then, but now that he's older and she's just as attractive, who knows what could happen? She might even seduce him herself!
